units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Amos 5:26">Targ. Am. V, 26</cite>.—
Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55ᵇ bot.; a. fr.—Esp. the planet Mercury.
Sabb. 156ᵃ האי מאן דבכ׳ he who was born under Mercury.—כ׳ נוגה, כ׳ נוגהא Venus. Targ. II Esth. II, 7 (v. אִיסְתִּירָא); Yalk. Esth. 1053 (hebr.), v. אִסְתְּהַר.—Sabb. l. c.; a. e.—כ׳ רשביט comet.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 1:16">Targ. Gen. I, 16</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 39a:5">Snh. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>מצינא למימני כ׳</he> I can count the stars.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 39a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>מני לי כ׳</he> the number of the stars is known to me.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 29a:6">Ab. Zar. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>דתלי לה בי כ׳</he> which he suspended under the stars (in open air over night); a. fr.—[<cite ref="Bava Metzia 86a:12">B. Mets. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>כֹּכְבִין דנרדא</he> Ar. balls of nardus, ed. <he>כִּכְּרִין</he>.]
